title: Roasted Elegant Potatoes with Mediterranean Herbs
description: A simple yet flavorful side dish that's perfect for any meal. The combination of elegant potatoes, mediterranean herbs, and a hint of lemon zest creates a delicious and aromatic roasted potato dish.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with olive oil, rosemary, oregano, garlic, and lemon zest until they're evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they're golden brown and crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Serve the roasted potatoes hot, garnished with additional rosemary and oregano if desired.
